title: English–Hindi emotion benchmark: split identifiers, translations and code
description: Exact train, validation and test splits of the five-class English–Hindi emotion benchmark, released as sentence identifiers (GoEmotions comment IDs, BHAAV row numbers and SHA-1 hashes) with a script that rebuilds every split from the public corpora; the 1,334 machine-translated Hindi surprise sentences derived from XED; and the experiment code and saved results.
